scope: Descriptive early-economy readback, no causal or native win-rate estimate. No game/config/lease/force changes.
baseline_kind: Retrospective fixed first-eight queue-correction segments; known first seven archived with no outcomes/production-share stop.
future_kind: Prospective first-eight attempt segments from first confirmed merged PR4170 BFS source/first decision. Same membership as the prepared observer. Do not replace missing, retired, continued, changed-source or changed-profile segments.
production_metric: Actual agent kind=turn major_production local_player reading; report our production, largest readable rival production and ratio at each exact turn. Missing exact turn remains missing.
state_metrics: First and last exported state at each exact turn: cities, completed Monuments (city.buildings), culture, science, gold, GPT, government, built Settlers and ongoing city production. No interpolation.
end_metrics: Preserve actual native outcome/stop reason/turn and production_share reading. Stops have no game outcome, not a loss or replacement.
limits: Operator production-share stops can censor all outcomes.
Immortal starting advantages, different seeds, unrelated source/profile changes and overlapping cohorts prevent causal attribution.
A higher early metric is not a demonstrated win-rate improvement.
